items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: he was here in New York for a while.

ctx.x: Supposedly, I seem to remember that Tony Perry(?) had some thing of yours when you played with him. That's much later, of course.
Yeah... I don't know where the hell that comes from. Now that I think of it, he was here in New York for a while. Yeah.
